entities.name: federal republicanism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Ideology, prevalent mainly in the 19th century spain, which incorporates republicanism and advocates local associations of citizens and promotes citizen participation in public affairs, alongside decentralisation or devolution of power. federal republicanism is a political ideology.
